'''Pizilis''' was a [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]]&ndash;type [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. It was located within the [[Pizilis system/Legends|Pizilis system]] of the [[Terr'skiar sector/Legends|Terr'skiar sector]], a part of the [[Kashyyyk Region/Legends|Kashyyyk Region]] in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. The [[Dauntless Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] connected the planet to the world of [[Rorgam]] while the [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route known as the [[Nightroad/Legends|Nightroad]] linked Pizilis to the worlds of [[Mytaranor]] and [[Terr'skiar]].<ref name="TEA" />

The [[Sapphire/Legends|sapphire]]-[[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Gas/Legends|gas]] giant had several [[Moon/Legends|moons]] that all had [[Temperature/Legends|temperate]] climates. The moons had many small settlements on them that were supported by corporations out of the worlds of [[Lantillies/Legends|Lantillies]], [[Randon/Legends|Randon]] and Rorgam.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pizilis was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the planet in grid square P-10.<ref name="TEA" />
